reasoning_traces.think:
The core challenge is converting predictive uncertainty into actionable financial decisions. Standard accuracy metrics (e.g., classification rate) optimize for point predictions but ignore the magnitude of probability estimates. In contrast, calibration measures how well predicted probabilities reflect true frequencies across bins of predictions. For Kelly betting, which maximizes geometric mean wealth growth, only calibrated probabilities guarantee optimal bet sizing. Miscalibrated models lead to either over-betting (risk of ruin) or under-betting (wasting growth potential). Our experiments demonstrate that selecting models based on calibration metrics yields significantly higher ROI than accuracy-based selection, especially in high-volume betting scenarios where small improvements compound.
